events.title: Western Emperor Majorian is executed on Ricimer's orders
events.description: Majorian, the last Western emperor to attempt a real recovery of the empire, was arrested and beheaded by his general Ricimer. Afterwards Ricimer ruled through puppet emperors.
events.html: Majorian, the last Western emperor to attempt a real recovery of the empire, was arrested and beheaded by his general Ricimer. Afterwards Ricimer ruled through puppet emperors.

events.title: George Washington creates the Badge of Military Merit
events.description: Washington established a purple cloth heart to honour enlisted soldiers for meritorious action. Revived in 1932 as the Purple Heart, it is now awarded to those wounded or killed in US service.
events.html: Washington established a purple cloth heart to honour enlisted soldiers for meritorious action. Revived in 1932 as the Purple Heart, it is now awarded to those wounded or killed in US service.

events.title: Simón Bolívar wins the Battle of Boyacá
events.description: After a daring march over the Andes, Bolívar's army defeated the royalists at Boyacá. Bogotá fell days later, securing the independence of New Granada, present-day Colombia.
events.html: After a daring march over the Andes, Bolívar's army defeated the royalists at Boyacá. Bogotá fell days later, securing the independence of New Granada, present-day Colombia.

events.title: US Marines land on Guadalcanal
events.description: US Marines landed on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands, the first major American offensive of the Pacific war. Six months of fighting ended in a Japanese withdrawal.
events.html: US Marines landed on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands, the first major American offensive of the Pacific war. Six months of fighting ended in a Japanese withdrawal.

events.title: Thor Heyerdahl's Kon-Tiki raft reaches Polynesia
events.description: After 101 days and some 7,000 km from Peru, Thor Heyerdahl's balsa raft ran onto the reef at Raroia. The voyage showed that prehistoric people could have crossed the Pacific on such craft.
events.html: After 101 days and some 7,000 km from Peru, Thor Heyerdahl's balsa raft ran onto the reef at Raroia. The voyage showed that prehistoric people could have crossed the Pacific on such craft.

events.title: Al-Qaeda bombs US embassies in Kenya and Tanzania
events.description: Truck bombs exploded almost simultaneously at the US embassies in Nairobi and Dar es Salaam, killing 224 people, most of them Africans. The attacks brought Osama bin Laden to world attention.
events.html: Truck bombs exploded almost simultaneously at the US embassies in Nairobi and Dar es Salaam, killing 224 people, most of them Africans. The attacks brought Osama bin Laden to world attention.
